triView.model.title: Integrated Load Model — Calculation
triView.model.desc: Total CTL = Cycling CTL + Running CTL + Swimming CTL (simple sum). Each discipline's TSS is computed independently as a 42-day EWMA, and the summed total CTL represents overall fitness. TSB (form) — the difference between CTL and ATL (7-day average) — is positive when recovered and negative when fatigued.

raceEstimates.title: Race record reference estimates
raceEstimates.scope: Reference times use genuine maximal efforts. Only explicitly chosen results are saved.
raceEstimates.partial: Partial or capped evidence was checked. This does not establish an all-history personal best.
raceEstimates.unsupported: Evidence is unavailable. You can enter a race record directly.
raceEstimates.noSources: No qualifying record in the inspected window. Enter a race record directly.
raceEstimates.maximal: This record was a maximal effort for this distance.
raceEstimates.typical: This is my usual mileage during marathon preparation.
raceEstimates.mileageNote: The marathon reference estimate needs typical training mileage, which can differ from the latest weekly total.
raceEstimates.invalid: Provide an actual time, date and maximal-effort confirmation. Confirm typical mileage if supplied.
raceEstimates.error: Evidence could not be confirmed. Reload activity evidence or check your input.
raceEstimates.saveUnknown: The save outcome is unknown. It may already be saved; retry the same request to confirm.
raceEstimates.disclaimer: Actual results vary with weather, course and training. Numerical accuracy has not been validated for ORider users.
raceEstimates.clockNote: Activities use producer elapsed time. The original sensor clock is not independently verified. Direct input is a user statement.
raceEstimates.historyNote: 1, 3 and 6 months mean the latest 30, 90 and 180 days. Only actual saved results are shown; past results are never fabricated.
raceEstimates.emptyHistory: No saved reference estimates in this window.
raceEstimates.onePoint: One saved point does not establish a growth trend.
raceEstimates.sourceChanged: Historical saved result. Its source has changed or cannot be confirmed; this is not a current prediction.
raceEstimates.capped: Only the latest 64 saved points within 180 days are inspected, not all history.

outcome.stored_source_checked: Saved, with sources checked immediately afterward.

outcome.idempotent_historical_replay: Result already saved by the same request, not a newly calculated current prediction.

native.title: Twelve-duration power comparison
native.scope: Select up to two loaded ORider activities. These are not account-wide personal bests.

native.clock: Compared using stored one-second slots. Original clock and sensor bucket origin are unverified.

native.calendarBasis: UTC dates · end date included · today ends at the request time

powerEffort.title: Exclude or restore power efforts
powerEffort.scope: Compare the next eligible effort after exclusions within selected, checked activities. Originals are unchanged; this is not an account lifetime best.
powerEffort.confirmed: Saved. Check again to see the updated comparison.
powerEffort.pending: The saved decision needs a current-source check. Check again.

comparison.title: Comparison periods
comparison.timezone: Dates use Korea Standard Time (KST). Custom end dates are inclusive; today ends at the request time.
comparison.rollingNote: The recent 56 days are a rolling 56 × 24-hour window ending at the request time. All history is also subject to the scan limit.
comparison.yearToDate: Year to date vs previous year
comparison.fourWeeksNote: Compare the last 28 complete days, excluding today, with the preceding 28 days.
comparison.yearToDateNote: Compare from January 1 to the same month, day and time in each year. February 29 maps to February 28 in the previous year.
periodCurve.populationBasis: Power curves take measured maxima from up to 1,000 records per period. Linked originals and copies are compared separately, so included activity counts may differ from distance and time totals.
